filters.basis: Note E or R marks a probable HII region or background galaxy, and 'other' an object excluded as a planetary nebula by its flux (ReadMe note 1).
A host marks an object of M32, NGC 205, Andromeda IV, the Northern Spur, a possible Southern Stream extension or a background source (ReadMe note 2).

frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc M31's image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

meaning: Planetary nebulae of M31 from the Planetary Nebula Spectrograph survey of Merrett et al. (2006): one dot per nebula at its catalogue sky position. Of 3,300 emission-line objects, 2,574 remain once the authors' own flags for HII regions, background objects and other galaxies are applied. The planetary nebulae trace M31's old stars, bulge and disc alike.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the planetary-nebula colour of the M33 dots, so the two galaxies read alike.
